While High Government Debt Levels Could Hasten Economic Recovery

Post Recession, There Are Many Long-Term Negative Consequences

Crowding Out Investment =» Lower Output & Income

~ A growing portion of people's savings would be diverted to purchase government debt rather than toward investment in productive capital goods.

Higher Interest Payments = Higher Tax Rates & Lower Output & Income — Government may be forced to raise marginal tax rates and / or reduce spending on other programs to meet interest payments.
e Reduced Ability to Borrow > Less Policy Flexibility — In case of economic downturns or international crises, government may not be able to raise substantially more debt.
